# Issue Templates

Use the templates in this folder to report bugs or request features.

## Available Templates

- `bug_report.md`: use this when FlexAgent behaves incorrectly or fails at runtime.
- `feature_request.md`: use this when you want to propose a new capability or improvement.

## Before Opening an Issue

- Search existing issues first to avoid duplicates.
- Include the runtime adapter, JDK version, and reproduction steps.
- Attach logs or screenshots when they help explain the problem.

If the issue is about docs, setup, or maintenance, feel free to point to the relevant page directly from the template.
